title: planchonella costata
intro: Planchonella costata, commonly known as the wild orange or yellow sapote, is a tropical tree native to the Pacific Islands, particularly in the islands of New Caledonia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Planchonella costata include its antiseptic, antifungal, and antibacterial properties, which make it useful in treating wounds and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
